notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 2, 9, 10, 11, 12, 18, 19, 20,
and 28. These questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered different
parts of the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 3, 4, 5 and 22. These
questions were answered correctly by 50% or fewer candidates. The rest of the questions gave results which
were well within the levels expected.
